clinic.name: Lupyana Polyclinic
clinic.intro: Lupyana Polyclinic is a 24-hour health centre in Vwawa, Mbozi, Songwe. We provide outpatient and inpatient care, surgical services, X-ray and laboratory diagnostics, and specialist care for mothers, children and eyes.
clinic.history: Lupyana Polyclinic serves families in Vwawa, Mbozi and the wider Songwe region from its premises on Florida Street. The clinic is open 24 hours a day and brings outpatient and inpatient care, surgical services, X-ray and laboratory diagnostics, dental and eye clinics, and maternal and child health services together in one place. Its departments cover general medicine, obstetrics and gynaecology, paediatrics, child growth and development, and maternal care. When a patient needs specialist care that the clinic does not provide, the team arranges a referral to a higher-level hospital.
clinic.mission: To provide accessible, safe and respectful health care to the people of Vwawa, Mbozi and Songwe at any hour — combining general medical care with surgical, diagnostic and specialist services, and referring patients promptly when more specialised care is needed.
clinic.values: Care for every patient with dignity and respect. Stay open 24 hours a day for urgent and routine care. Be honest about what the clinic can and cannot treat, and refer promptly. Protect patient privacy and keep health information confidential. Work with the community and keep improving the safety and quality of care.
clinic.keyFacts: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Services include outpatient (OPD) and inpatient (IPD) care, surgery, X-ray, laboratory tests, dental, eye, maternal, child growth and gynaecology care.
clinic.physicalAddress: Vwawa, Florida Street (near the Church of God the Father)
clinic.hours: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
clinic.emergency: The clinic is open 24 hours a day. For urgent medical help, call 0726 498 771 or WhatsApp 0743 879 805.
clinic.brandColours: Primary teal #0B5D5A, deep teal #074643, pale teal #DCEFEC, ink #0F2A2A and soft surface #F5F9F8.
clinic.serviceList: Outpatient (OPD), inpatient (IPD), surgery, X-ray, laboratory, and specialist maternal, child and eye care.

clinic.facilities: The health centre has outpatient and inpatient departments, an operating theatre, X-ray and laboratory services, and dedicated maternal, child and eye care.

sw.tagline: Huduma ya afya saa 24 Vwawa, Mbozi
sw.intro: Kliniki ya Lupyana ni kituo cha afya cha saa 24 huko Vwawa, Mbozi, Songwe. Tunatoa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje na wa kulazwa, huduma za upasuaji, eksirei na uchunguzi wa maabara, na huduma maalum kwa mama, watoto na macho.
sw.keyFacts: Imefunguliwa saa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki. Huduma ni pamoja na wagonjwa wa nje (OPD) na wa kulazwa (IPD), upasuaji, eksirei, vipimo vya maabara, meno, macho, mama, ukuaji wa mtoto na magonjwa ya wanawake.

sw.serviceList: Wagonjwa wa nje (OPD), wa kulazwa (IPD), upasuaji, eksirei, maabara, na huduma maalum za mama, mtoto na macho.
sw.departments: Meno, macho, uzazi, magonjwa ya wanawake, watoto, ukuaji wa mtoto, huduma za mama na kliniki ya jumla.
sw.facilities: Kituo cha afya kina wodi za wagonjwa wa nje na wa kulazwa, chumba cha upasuaji, huduma za eksirei na maabara, na kitengo cha uzazi na afya ya mtoto.
sw.labServices: Vipimo vya maabara na huduma za uchunguzi zinazounga mkono huduma za wagonjwa wa nje, wa kulazwa, mama na mtoto.

sw.photos: Picha za miundombinu huchapishwa tu baada ya kliniki kuziidhinisha.
sw.history: Kliniki ya Lupyana inahudumia familia za Vwawa, Mbozi na kanda nzima ya Songwe kutoka eneo lake katika barabara ya Florida. Kliniki iko wazi saa 24 kwa siku na inaunganisha huduma za wagonjwa wa nje na wa kulazwa, upasuaji, eksirei na maabara, kliniki za meno na macho, na huduma za afya ya mama na mtoto mahali pamoja. Idara zake zinajumuisha huduma ya jumla, uzazi na magonjwa ya wanawake, watoto, ukuaji na maendeleo ya mtoto, na huduma za mama. Mgonjwa anapohitaji huduma maalum ambazo kliniki haitoi, timu hupanga rufaa kwa hospitali ya ngazi ya juu.
sw.mission: Kutoa huduma ya afya inayopatikana kwa urahisi, salama na yenye heshima kwa watu wa Vwawa, Mbozi na Songwe saa yoyote — kwa kuunganisha huduma ya jumla na huduma za upasuaji, uchunguzi na utaalamu, na kuwapeleka wagonjwa kwa rufaa haraka pale huduma maalum zaidi inapohitajika.
sw.values: Kumjali kila mgonjwa kwa heshima na utu. Kubaki wazi saa 24 kwa siku kwa huduma za dharura na za kawaida. Kuwa wakweli kuhusu kile kliniki inaweza na kisichoweza kutibu, na kupeleka rufaa haraka. Kulinda faragha ya mgonjwa na kuhifadhi taarifa za afya kwa siri. Kushirikiana na jamii na kuendelea kuboresha usalama na ubora wa huduma.

en.privacy.hero.title: Privacy and terms
en.privacy.hero.lead: How this website handles the details you send through the enquiry form, and the terms that apply when you use the site.
en.privacy.collect.title: What the enquiry form collects
en.privacy.collect.body: When you send an enquiry, the form collects your full name, phone or WhatsApp number, preferred date and time, the service you are interested in, and an optional short message. It also records the language you used and the page you sent it from. The form does not ask for medical history, diagnoses, prescriptions or other sensitive health information, and the website does not create a patient record. Your browser also stores your language, theme and cookie choice in local storage; this information stays on your device and is not sent to the clinic.
en.privacy.receivers.title: Who receives it
en.privacy.receivers.body: The form is delivered by Google Apps Script to the clinic's mailbox, where clinic staff read and answer it. Google processes the message as the email provider. If you choose the WhatsApp option instead, your message is handled by WhatsApp (Meta) under its own terms. The company that hosts this website may process standard server logs, such as the pages requested and the date and time, to keep the site running and secure.
en.privacy.health.title: No sensitive health data
en.privacy.health.body: The form asks for contact details, a preferred date and time, a service of interest and a short message. It does not ask for medical history, diagnoses or prescriptions.
en.privacy.retention.title: How long it is kept
en.privacy.retention.body: Enquiries are kept in the clinic's email mailbox only for as long as needed to respond and for the clinic's normal records. The website itself does not store enquiries in a database. The language, theme and cookie preferences saved in your browser stay there until you clear your browser data or change them.
en.privacy.rights.title: Your choices
en.privacy.rights.body: You can ask the clinic what enquiry details it holds about you, ask for a correction, or ask for them to be deleted. You can also withdraw your consent to be contacted at any time. Call or WhatsApp 0726 498 771. You can use the phone or WhatsApp instead of the form at any time.
en.privacy.contact.title: Privacy contact
en.privacy.contact.body: For privacy questions, contact Lupyana Polyclinic by phone or WhatsApp on 0726 498 771.
en.privacy.terms.title: Terms of use
en.privacy.terms.body: This website gives general information about Lupyana Polyclinic and its services. It is not medical advice and it does not replace a consultation with a health professional. In an emergency, call the clinic on 0726 498 771 or go to the nearest emergency department; do not wait for a reply to an online enquiry. Service lists, opening hours and availability can change, so please call or WhatsApp to confirm before you travel. An appointment enquiry is a request only and is not a confirmed booking until the clinic contacts you. Links to other websites are provided for convenience; the clinic is not responsible for their content. The clinic may update this page and the site content at any time. These terms are governed by the laws of Tanzania.
en.privacy.review.note: Last updated 12 November 2026. This notice explains how this website handles enquiries. It does not replace the clinic's patient records and confidentiality policy; ask the clinic for its full data-protection policy.
en.footer.privacyNote: Please do not send medical history, diagnoses or prescriptions through this website.

sw.privacy.receivers.title: Nani anapokea
sw.privacy.receivers.body: Fomu huwasilishwa na Google Apps Script kwenye sanduku la barua la kliniki, ambako wafanyakazi wa kliniki huisona na kuijibu. Google hushughulikia ujumbe kama mtoa huduma wa barua pepe. Ukichagua WhatsApp badala yake, ujumbe wako hushughulikiwa na WhatsApp (Meta) chini ya masharti yake. Kampuni inayopangisha tovuti hii inaweza kushughulikia kumbukumbu za kawaida za seva, kama kurasa zilizoombwa na tarehe na saa, ili kuendesha tovuti kwa usalama.
sw.privacy.health.title: Hakuna data nyeti za afya
sw.privacy.health.body: Fomu inaomba maelezo ya mawasiliano, tarehe na saa unayopendelea, huduma unayovutiwa nayo na ujumbe mfupi. Haiombi historia ya matibabu, utambuzi au maagizo ya dawa.
sw.privacy.retention.title: Inahifadhiwa kwa muda gani
sw.privacy.retention.body: Maulizo huhifadhiwa kwenye sanduku la barua pepe la kliniki kwa muda unaohitajika kujibu tu na kwa kumbukumbu za kawaida za kliniki. Tovuti yenyewe haihifadhi maulizo kwenye hifadhidata. Lugha, mandhari na mapendeleo ya vidakuzi yaliyohifadhiwa kwenye kivinjari chako hubaki hapo hadi utakapofuta data ya kivinjari chako au kuyabadilisha.
sw.privacy.rights.title: Chaguo zako
sw.privacy.rights.body: Unaweza kuuliza kliniki ni maelezo gani ya swali iliyonayo kukuhusu, kuomba marekebisho, au kuomba yafutwe. Unaweza pia kuondoa idhini yako ya kuwasiliana nawe wakati wowote. Piga simu au WhatsApp 0726 498 771. Unaweza kutumia simu au WhatsApp badala ya fomu wakati wowote.
sw.privacy.contact.title: Mawasiliano ya faragha
sw.privacy.contact.body: Kwa maswali ya faragha, wasiliana na Kliniki ya Lupyana kwa simu au WhatsApp 0726 498 771.
sw.privacy.terms.title: Masharti ya matumizi
sw.privacy.terms.body: Tovuti hii inatoa taarifa za jumla kuhusu Kliniki ya Lupyana na huduma zake. Si ushauri wa matibabu na haichukui nafasi ya ushauri na mtaalamu wa afya. Katika dharura, piga simu kliniki kwa 0726 498 771 au nenda moja kwa moja kwenye idara ya dharura iliyo karibu; usisubiri jibu la swali la mtandaoni. Orodha ya huduma, saa za kufungua na upatikanaji vinaweza kubadilika, kwa hiyo tafadhali piga simu au WhatsApp kuthibitisha kabla ya kusafiri. Ombi la miadi ni ombi tu na si miadi iliyothibitishwa hadi kliniki itakapowasiliana nawe. Viungo vya tovuti nyingine vinatolewa kwa urahisi; kliniki haiwajibiki kwa maudhui yao. Kliniki inaweza kusasisha ukurasa huu na maudhui ya tovuti wakati wowote. Masharti haya yanaongozwa na sheria za Tanzania.
sw.privacy.review.note: Imesasishwa tarehe 12 Novemba 2026. Taarifa hii inaeleza jinsi tovuti hii inavyoshughulikia maulizo. Haichukui nafasi ya sera ya kliniki ya rekodi za wagonjwa na usiri; omba kliniki sera yake kamili ya ulinzi wa data.
sw.footer.privacyNote: Tafadhali usitume historia ya matibabu, utambuzi au maagizo ya dawa kupitia tovuti hii.
sw.notfound.title: Ukurasa haujapatikana
sw.notfound.body: Ukurasa unaoutafuta haupo au umehamishwa. Tumia viungo hapa chini kuendelea.

sw.meta.about.desc: Jifunze kuhusu Kliniki ya Lupyana huko Mbozi, Songwe: historia, dhamira, maadili, miundombinu na picha zilizoidhinishwa.
sw.meta.services.title: Huduma za Matibabu | Kliniki ya Lupyana
sw.meta.services.desc: Huduma za matibabu katika Kliniki ya Lupyana, ikiwa ni pamoja na huduma za wagonjwa wa nje na wa kulazwa, upasuaji, eksirei, maabara, meno, macho, mama na afya ya mtoto. Piga simu au WhatsApp kuthibitisha upatikanaji.

sw.meta.team.desc: Madaktari na timu ya matibabu katika Kliniki ya Lupyana. Wasifu huchapishwa tu kwa idhini ya maandishi.

desc.en: Walk-in and referred patients are seen by our clinical team for consultation, diagnosis, treatment and follow-up. The outpatient department handles common illnesses, injuries and chronic conditions, and refers patients to specialist departments or higher-level hospitals when needed.
desc.sw: Wagonjwa wanaofika moja kwa moja na wale waliopelekwa huonwa na timu yetu ya kliniki kwa ushauri, uchunguzi, matibabu na ufuatiliaji. Idara ya wagonjwa wa nje inashughulikia magonjwa ya kawaida, majeraha na hali sugu, na huwapeleka wagonjwa kwa idara maalum au hospitali za ngazi ya juu inapohitajika.

desc.en: Patients who need observation, treatment or recovery under continuous care are admitted to our inpatient wards. The team provides 24-hour nursing observation, medication, wound care and monitoring, with doctors reviewing admitted patients daily.
desc.sw: Wagonjwa wanaohitaji uangalizi, matibabu au kupona chini ya huduma endelevu hulazwa katika wodi zetu za wagonjwa wa kulazwa. Timu hutoa uangalizi wa wauguzi saa 24, dawa, huduma ya majeraha na ufuatiliaji, huku madaktari wakikagua wagonjwa waliolazwa kila siku.

desc.en: We provide surgical care in our operating theatre, including minor and major procedures, wound care and post-operative follow-up. Patients are assessed before surgery and monitored during recovery; cases needing specialist or referral surgery are arranged accordingly.
desc.sw: Tunatoa huduma za upasuaji katika chumba chetu cha upasuaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na taratibu ndogo na kubwa, huduma ya majeraha na ufuatiliaji wa baada ya upasuaji. Wagonjwa hupimwa kabla ya upasuaji na kufuatiliwa wakati wa kupona; kesi zinazohitaji upasuaji maalum au rufaa hupangwa ipasavyo.

desc.en: Our X-ray service supports the diagnosis of fractures, chest conditions and other internal problems. Imaging is requested by a clinician, and the results are explained and used to plan your treatment.
desc.sw: Huduma yetu ya eksirei inasaidia utambuzi wa mivunjiko, magonjwa ya kifua na matatizo mengine ya ndani. Picha huombwa na daktari, na matokeo huelezwa na kutumika kupanga matibabu yako.

desc.en: The laboratory runs blood, urine, stool and other diagnostic tests to confirm illness, guide treatment and monitor progress. Results are reviewed by clinicians and shared with you as part of your consultation.
desc.sw: Maabara hufanya vipimo vya damu, mkojo, kinyesi na vipimo vingine vya uchunguzi ili kuthibitisha ugonjwa, kuongoza matibabu na kufuatilia maendeleo. Matokeo hupitiwa na madaktari na kushirikiwa nawe kama sehemu ya ushauri wako.

name.en: Specialist maternal, child and eye care
name.sw: Huduma maalum za mama, mtoto na macho

desc.en: Specialist clinics cover pregnancy and postnatal care, child health and growth monitoring, and eye care. Mothers, children and eye patients receive assessment, treatment, health education and follow-up from the appropriate department.
desc.sw: Kliniki maalum zinashughulikia huduma za ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua, afya ya mtoto na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji, na huduma za macho. Mama, watoto na wagonjwa wa macho hupata uchunguzi, matibabu, elimu ya afya na ufuatiliaji kutoka idara husika.

department.en: Maternal Care, Pediatrics and Eye Clinic
department.sw: Huduma za Mama, Watoto na Kliniki ya Macho

desc.en: The dental clinic provides oral health assessment, tooth extraction, scaling and cleaning, treatment of dental pain and infection, and advice on oral hygiene. Patients with complex dental needs are referred to a dental hospital.
desc.sw: Kliniki ya meno hutoa uchunguzi wa afya ya kinywa, kung'oa meno, kusafisha meno, matibabu ya maumivu na maambukizi ya meno, na ushauri wa usafi wa kinywa. Wagonjwa wenye mahitaji magumu ya meno hupelekwa hospitali ya meno.

desc.en: The eye clinic examines vision and eye health, treats common eye infections and injuries, and provides spectacles and optical advice. Patients needing specialist eye surgery are referred to an eye hospital.
desc.sw: Kliniki ya macho huchunguza uwezo wa kuona na afya ya macho, hutibu maambukizi na majeraha ya kawaida ya macho, na hutoa miwani na ushauri wa macho. Wagonjwa wanaohitaji upasuaji maalum wa macho hupelekwa hospitali ya macho.

desc.en: Obstetrics covers antenatal care, monitoring of pregnancy, safe delivery and postnatal review. Mothers receive check-ups, health education and support for a safe pregnancy and birth, with referral for complicated cases.
desc.sw: Uzazi unajumuisha huduma ya ujauzito, ufuatiliaji wa ujauzito, kujifungua salama na mapitio ya baada ya kujifungua. Mama hupata vipimo, elimu ya afya na msaada kwa ujauzito na kujifungua salama, pamoja na rufaa kwa kesi zilizo ngumu.

desc.en: The gynaecology service assesses and treats women's reproductive health concerns, including menstrual problems, infections, pelvic pain and family planning advice. Confidential consultation and follow-up are provided.
desc.sw: Huduma ya magonjwa ya wanawake hupima na kutibu matatizo ya afya ya uzazi ya wanawake, ikiwa ni pamoja na matatizo ya hedhi, maambukizi, maumivu ya pelvic na ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango. Ushauri wa faragha na ufuatiliaji hutolewa.

desc.en: Pediatrics cares for infants, children and adolescents, including assessment and treatment of childhood illnesses, injuries and infections. Children are monitored, treated and referred when specialist care is needed.
desc.sw: Huduma ya watoto inawatunza watoto wachanga, watoto na vijana, ikiwa ni pamoja na uchunguzi na matibabu ya magonjwa ya utotoni, majeraha na maambukizi. Watoto hufuatiliwa, kutibiwa na kupelekwa kwa rufaa pale huduma maalum inapohitajika.

desc.en: This service monitors child growth, nutrition and development through regular weighing, measurements and developmental checks. Parents receive guidance on feeding, nutrition and early detection of growth or developmental problems.
desc.sw: Huduma hii hufuatilia ukuaji, lishe na maendeleo ya mtoto kupitia uzani wa mara kwa mara, vipimo na ukaguzi wa maendeleo. Wazazi hupata mwongozo wa lishe, ulishaji na utambuzi wa mapema wa matatizo ya ukuaji au maendeleo.

desc.en: Maternal care supports women before, during and after pregnancy with antenatal check-ups, health education, nutrition advice and postnatal follow-up. Mothers are linked to delivery and child health services within the clinic.
desc.sw: Huduma za mama zinasaidia wanawake kabla, wakati na baada ya ujauzito kwa vipimo vya ujauzito, elimu ya afya, ushauri wa lishe na ufuatiliaji wa baada ya kujifungua. Mama huunganishwa na huduma za kujifungua na afya ya mtoto ndani ya kliniki.

desc.en: The general clinic is the entry point for most patients, providing outpatient consultation, diagnosis, treatment, wound care and referral. It coordinates with the laboratory, X-ray, inpatient and specialist departments.
desc.sw: Kliniki ya jumla ni lango la wagonjwa wengi, ikitoa ushauri wa wagonjwa wa nje, uchunguzi, matibabu, huduma ya majeraha na rufaa. Inashirikiana na maabara, eksirei, wodi za kulazwa na idara maalum.

name.sw: Wodi za wagonjwa wa nje na wa kulazwa

desc.en: Consultation rooms and inpatient wards where patients are seen, admitted, observed and treated, with 24-hour nursing care.
desc.sw: Vyumba vya ushauri na wodi za wagonjwa wa kulazwa ambako wagonjwa huonwa, hulazwa, huangaliwa na kutibiwa, pamoja na huduma ya wauguzi saa 24.

desc.en: A dedicated theatre for surgical procedures, with pre-operative assessment and post-operative recovery monitoring.
desc.sw: Chumba maalum cha upasuaji kwa taratibu za upasuaji, pamoja na uchunguzi wa kabla ya upasuaji na ufuatiliaji wa kupona baada ya upasuaji.

desc.en: On-site diagnostic services for imaging and laboratory tests, supporting faster diagnosis and treatment decisions.
desc.sw: Huduma za uchunguzi ndani ya kituo kwa picha na vipimo vya maabara, zinazosaidia utambuzi wa haraka na maamuzi ya matibabu.

name.sw: Kitengo cha uzazi na afya ya mtoto

desc.en: A unit for antenatal, delivery, postnatal and child health services, including growth monitoring and health education.
desc.sw: Kitengo cha huduma za ujauzito, kujifungua, baada ya kujifungua na afya ya mtoto, ikiwa ni pamoja na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji na elimu ya afya.
